goal: 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 long-video watch hours in 12 months (or 10M Shorts views in 90 days) for the YouTube Partner Program. The lower 500-subscriber tier isn't open in Ghana yet.

references.title: How to grow your views (Facebook video)
references.note: Watch on Facebook. Add its tips to the checklist below.

checklist.text: Post 1 Short: a 12 s product clip, price hook in the first second, on-screen text and #shorts. Post 2–3 a day in the first week.
Reply to every comment within a few hours. Pin the best question or answer.
Share the newest video free on WhatsApp Status, TikTok, FB/IG Reels with "Full video on YouTube" + the channel link.
Spend 5 min in YouTube Studio → Inspiration / Research. Use what people search for (e.g. "school desk price Ghana") in your next titles.
Leave 2–3 helpful comments on Ghanaian home, interior or school channels. No links in them.
On every Short, set "Related video" to the matching long video. Also say "full room design on my channel" in a pinned comment.
Put the search keyword in the title, e.g. "Designing a budget living room | Odorkor-made sofa".
First 2 lines of the description: price, WhatsApp link, favisionenterprize.github.io. Then chapters from 0:00.
End screen: Subscribe button + "Best for viewer" video or a playlist.
Custom thumbnail on long videos: finished room + price, readable on a phone.
Add the video to a playlist: School Desks · Sofas · Dining Sets · Beds · Design It With Me.
Ask for one action: "Comment your room size and I'll design it next". No rewards for likes or subscribes.
Post 2–3 times on the Posts tab: a poll ("Which sofa colour next?"), a before/after, a new-stock teaser.
Make 1 viewer-request design video from the comments.
Try 1 collaboration with a similar-size Ghanaian creator (interior, carpentry, teachers, Airbnb hosts).
In Analytics, check "viewed vs swiped away" on Shorts and average view duration on long videos. Remake the winners.
Send the week's best video to WhatsApp broadcast lists and school administrators (desks).
Cut one long video into 3–5 Shorts.
No sub4sub, bought views or subscribers, view bots or "free subscriber" apps. YouTube can delete the channel.
No like/comment-swap groups and no "subscribe to win" giveaways.
No misleading titles or thumbnails (wrong prices, stock photos that aren't your furniture).
No off-topic viral Shorts. They bring subscribers who never buy furniture.
